principles.title: Similarity is not authority
principles.explanation: Shared circumstances do not automatically confer the right to represent others or speak in their name.

principles.title: Ratification is not commitment
principles.explanation: Approving a collective position is not the same as binding oneself to it unconditionally.

principles.title: Supplier response is not participant value
principles.explanation: A supplier acknowledging a collective position does not mean participants benefit from it.

principles.title: Transaction is not success
principles.explanation: A completed transaction does not confirm that the collective process improved on individual alternatives.

principles.title: Rights floors are non-compensable
principles.explanation: Privacy, exit, and contestability rights cannot be traded away in exchange for better terms.

principles.title: Do not aggregate is a valid result
principles.explanation: A decision not to form a collective position is a legitimate and complete research outcome.
